Attorney General Todd Blanche says the Justice Department

A Swiss diplomat is being expelled from North Korea.
It follows Switzerland's decision to impose sanctions
on Pyongyang.
NPR's Anthony Kunin Sol says the diplomat was one of the few
Western envoys left in that country.
North Korean state media report that the foreign ministry

Astier headed Switzerland's diplomatic office in Pyongyang,

The office is under Switzerland's embassy in China.
Switzerland has followed the UK and the European Union in

Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine.
North Korea called the Swiss sanctions a hostile act.
North Korea signed a mutual defense treaty with Russia in

fight Ukraine.
Anthony Kunin, PR News, Sol.
The U.S. Army says it will carry out the detonation of
nearly five tons of unstable lead azide today at an army
ammunition plant in southeast Iowa.
It's a compound used in explosives.
Tom Barton with Iowa Public Radio says some local residents
are being advised to leave the area temporarily.
The army says the material had been stored for decades at the
Middletown plant and formed crystals inside the drums
sensitive to shock, friction, and temperature.
The army says it considered chemical treatment,
but concluded the drums were too dangerous to open or move.
Acting Army Secretary Adam Tell says federal agencies agree a
plant blast is the safest option.
We don't want to give the public the feeling that there's
absolutely no risk.
The public needs to know what risk we understand and take

We're going to provide that information to them so they can
make that decision.
The army is urging residents in Middletown and in a zone
extending about five miles southwest of the plant to leave

For NPR News, I'm Tom Barton in Des Moines.

AAA says it expects nearly six million Americans to fly this
week for the long Thanksgiving holiday weekend.
That's a slight decrease from a year ago.

more to do so.
The big reason prices are up, jet fuel.

Jet fuel comes from crude oil and there's been less of that

Iran.

When it comes to the price of that jet fuel, air carriers are

Tickets for Thanksgiving are up about 30 percent compared to last

Willa Rubin, NPR News.
On this day before Thanksgiving, AAA says regular gasoline in

That's more than 50 cents a gallon higher than one year ago.

Two children were among those killed.
That Cessna went down yesterday in the Gulf of Mexico between
Pascagoula and Horn Island.
